description: TianFeng Patches 0.0.1-dev.8 development prerelease. Adds NetShort 2.2.9 client-side patches for ad suppression, member-state UI testing, member UI access, purchase-prompt cleanup, and coin-unlock UI testing. Existing YouTube Music Android Auto and Truecaller patches remain included. NetShort test-state patches do not modify server playback authorization, play vouchers, or real coin balances.
